# FanGraphs Baseball

> FanGraphs is a comprehensive baseball statistics and analysis platform offering MLB/MiLB data, fantasy tools, prospect coverage, and premium membership content.

FanGraphs provides advanced baseball analytics, player projections, and fantasy baseball tools through both free and premium membership tiers. The site hosts multiple editorial properties including RotoGraphs, The Hardball Times, and community blogs, plus the Ottoneu fantasy baseball platform.

## Key Topics

- Fantasy Baseball
- Baseball Statistics
- Player Projections
- MLB Analysis
- Prospect Rankings
- Draft Strategy
- Auction Drafts
- FanGraphs Membership
- Ottoneu
- RotoGraphs
- The Hardball Times
- Positional Rankings
- Player Rankings
- Baseball Culture
- Advanced Metrics

## Core Statistics & Tools

- [FanGraphs Baseball Homepage](https://www.fangraphs.com): FanGraphs homepage with MLB/MiLB statistics, analysis, and projections
- [Fantasy Player Rater](https://www.fangraphs.com/fantasy-tools/player-rater): Fantasy baseball player rater tool with projections and ADP tracking
- [Prospect Rankings & Coverage](https://www.fangraphs.com/prospects): FanGraphs prospect rankings and farm system analysis

## Fantasy Baseball Platforms

- [RotoGraphs Fantasy Baseball](https://www.fangraphs.com/rotographs): RotoGraphs fantasy baseball with draft analysis and player projections
- [Ottoneu Fantasy Baseball](https://ottoneu.fangraphs.com): Ottoneu fantasy baseball platform with dynasty leagues and auctions
- [Ottoneu Support](https://ottoneu.fangraphs.com/support): Ottoneu support with FAQ, pricing, and league setup guidance

## Premium Membership

- [FanGraphs Membership](https://www.fangraphs.com/plus): FanGraphs premium membership with advanced analysis and statistics
- [Membership Details](https://plus.fangraphs.com/product/fangraphs-membership): FanGraphs Membership subscription with ad-free access and premium features
- [Product Shop](https://plus.fangraphs.com/shop): FanGraphs product shop with memberships, gift cards, and merchandise
- [Gift Membership](https://plus.fangraphs.com/product/fangraphs-gift-membership): One-year FanGraphs Membership gift card product
- [FanGraphs Donation](https://plus.fangraphs.com/product/fangraphs-donation): One-time donation option supporting FanGraphs operations

## Editorial & Analysis

- [FanGraphs Daily Blog](https://www.fangraphs.com/blogs): FanGraphs daily blog with statistical analysis and player commentary
- [Blog Roll](https://www.fangraphs.com/blog-roll): FanGraphs blog aggregator with fantasy rankings and draft strategy
- [The Hardball Times](https://www.fangraphs.com/tht): The Hardball Times with baseball news, podcasts, and cultural commentary
- [Community Blog](https://www.fangraphs.com/community): FanGraphs community blog with Effectively Wild podcast and analysis
- [TechGraphs](https://www.fangraphs.com/techgraphs): TechGraphs covering sports technology and MLB news

## Optional & Archive

- [NotGraphs Baseball](https://www.fangraphs.com/not): NotGraphs humor blog (archived/shutdown)
- [THT Live Archives](https://www.fangraphs.com/tht/tht-live): The Hardball Times Live archive with historical baseball articles
